feedback:
Written before this candidate has raced, so no outcome is stated for it. The candidate is iteration 7 (score 219.96, the best raced design) with one change: the outer sensors move from y = 0.05 to y = 0.06 at x = -0.04 and +0.04. The geometry block states y = 0.06 explicitly. Controller gains and speed are unchanged from iteration 7: kp 3.0, ki 0.05, kd 0.5, base_speed 1.6, weights [-2,-1,0,1,2], line_loss last_direction. The candidate is valid against the contract.

The evidence for a further forward step is the earlier move from y = 0.03 to y = 0.05, which lifted oval progress from 0.67 to 0.74 (iteration 1 to iteration 6). Iteration 9 (ki 0.15) fell to 171.9 with oval progress 0.66, below the 0.70 threshold, so ki stays at 0.05. Iteration 8 (base_speed 1.8) fell to 136.1 with every run off track, so speed stays at 1.6. Line loss has stayed near 1.0 per run on every track in every raced iteration, and no lever so far has moved it. Iteration 6 showed the outer sensors can move forward without a loss of progress, so the y = 0.06 step is a reasonable test of the same effect. It is a single-variable change from the best design, and this is the second-last iteration, so the telemetry is needed for the final design.

What to do after the race, depending on the result:
- If oval progress is below 0.70 or s-bend progress is below 0.30, return the outer sensors to y = 0.05 (iteration 7). Use that design for the final iteration.
- If progress holds or rises and completions rise, keep y = 0.06 and consider a small further move (y = 0.07) only if s-bend progress also holds.
- If steering_oscillation rises well above the 0.35 seen on the oval in iteration 7, return to y = 0.05 before changing any gain.
- If line_loss_events stay near 1.0 with progress unchanged, the next lever is a line_loss behaviour change (search_left or search_right), not more ki or kp.
requested_changes: Keep the iteration 7 controller (kp 3.0, ki 0.05, kd 0.5, base_speed 1.6, line_loss last_direction) and change only the outer sensors' y from 0.05 to 0.06 at x = -0.04 and +0.04, as iteration 6 (y 0.03 to 0.05) showed forward sensing lifted oval progress from 0.67 to 0.74.

If oval progress falls below 0.70 or s-bend progress falls below 0.30 after the race, revert the outer sensors to y = 0.05 (iteration 7). Keep ki at 0.05, since iteration 9 (ki 0.15) dropped progress to 0.66 on the oval.

If line_loss_events stay near 1.0 per run with progress unchanged, test controller.line_loss = search_left or search_right in the final iteration instead of more ki or kp. Iterations 2, 5 and 9 showed kp, kd and ki changes did not reduce line loss.
